items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: He's still in Teaneck, New Jersey, I hear.

ctx.x: Well, there again, Al with his affliction, it was hard for him to keep up, and they would have really had to hire another person just to take care of Al, which he was such a good voice, that when he did leave or when he changed, he was able to hire another -- someone to take care of him. He did quite well. So I really don't know what happens in those cases. He's still in Teaneck, New Jersey, I hear. In fact, he came to L. A. not long ago for a stint at a little off club, but it wasn't too good, I hear.
This was when he played the Parisian a while back?
